name: Treachery
detailed_description:
Step into the abyss of Dante’s inferno in Treachery, a PlayStation 1-styled FPS that pays homage to the 90s classics like DOOM, Quake, and Half-Life! Immerse yourself in a nightmarish journey through the 9 circles of hell, with each level presenting challenging puzzles, unique weapons, and a relentless array of demonic foes!

Throughout the 9 episodes, each themed after the circles of hell, players will blast through plentiful hoards of treacherous enemies, journey through the labyrinth-like dungeons, and conquer unforgiving, nightmarish bosses. Featuring a hellish arsenal of unique and powerful weapons, Treachery allows you to forge your own path in crusading through hell!

  • Hellish Arsenal: Unleash chaos with a diverse range of weapons, each suited for different infernal encounters.
  • Boss Battles: Confront formidable demonic overlords, each with their own twisted design and challenging mechanics.
  • Puzzles and Platforming: Navigate through treacherous landscapes with a blend of mind-bending puzzles and adrenaline-pumping platforming elements.
  • Compelling Story: Embark on a desperate quest as a single father, driven by desperation, to traverse the depths of hell and rescue your kidnapped son from demonic clutches.
  • Atmospheric Design: Experience the unsettling ambience of each circle, accompanied by haunting visuals and a bone-chilling soundtrack.

Are you prepared to descend into the abyss and face the treacherous challenges that await? The fate of your son hangs in the balance. Welcome to hell, where salvation is earned through blood and bullets.
